<h2 id="armour"><ins><nowiki>Armour</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="general-armour-introduction"><nowiki>General Armour Introduction</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are three categories of armour:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Power</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: any armour with a style bonus</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Hybrid</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: anything stated as &quot;hybrid&quot;</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Tank</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: any other item (also has more armour than power / hybrid)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Armour tiers are based on the level required to equip them</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Equipping armour provides style and armour bonuses</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These bonuses are based on armour category and tier</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Generally armours in the same category and tier will have equal bonuses</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Wearing off-style armour slots (excluding cape slot) provides an accuracy penalty based on armour bonus</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• &quot;Off-style&quot; is any style that does not match your equipped main hand / 2H weapon</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hybrid gear incurs no penalty</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This penalty is near-doubled (0.8 → 1.5) when using the Necromancy combat style.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Some armour sets have </nowiki><strong><nowiki>set effects</nowiki></strong><nowiki> which may be useful</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ It is recommended to look up further information on the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Armoury <nowiki>Wiki</nowiki>]<nowiki>
⬥ Armour in </nowiki><strong><nowiki>bold</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is worth being aware of, they will be elaborated on after or are recommended in the respective upgrade order
⬥ Use </nowiki><code><nowiki>!armour</nowiki></code><nowiki> to see DPS difference between the armour
⬥ Generally speaking, use </nowiki><strong><nowiki>power armour</nowiki></strong><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ When </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is cast, the next </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to hit within 6s has all its remaining hits applied at once for 25% (40% with </nowiki><strong><nowiki>enchantment of flame</nowiki></strong><nowiki>) more damage
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Elite Dracolich Gloves</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179717613769728100.png?v=1" alt="edracogloves" title="edracogloves" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Adds to the passive effects from the armour set

    • </nowiki><em><nowiki>Dracolich infusion</nowiki></em><nowiki> at 3 pieces, after a full </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> gain +40% critical strike chance with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for 3 seconds, +1.8 seconds for every additional piece
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Nightmare Gauntlets</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159441723392.png?v=1" alt="NMG" title="NMG" kind="icon" /><nowiki>

</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Gloves of Passage</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694862037012.png?v=1" alt="glovesofpassage" title="glovesofpassage" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ After </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1" alt="rend" title="rend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is cast the following occurs (same target):
    • The next attack deals 10% (16% using </nowiki><strong><nowiki>agony enchantment</nowiki></strong><nowiki>) more damage

        ⬩ Does not affect </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063113659093075.png?v=1" alt="corruptionblast" title="corruptionblast" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1" alt="corruptshot" title="corruptshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &quot;bleeds&quot; as they are </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> bleeds
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Misc. Gloves</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Cinderbanes</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1" alt="Cinderbanes" title="Cinderbanes" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - increases poison damage, and can proc own poison hits
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Deathtouched Bracelet</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159429271562.png?v=1" alt="DTB" title="DTB" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - 20% chance to reflect 25-50% damage (7.5% average reflect) back to the attacker (does not reduce damage you take)
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Spellcaster's Gloves</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643214402169864213.png?v=1" alt="spellcaster" title="spellcaster" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - autos / basics have 5% chance to do 25% more damage, bind target, lower their combat stats by 7 levels and hit 1t after cast
    • Does not work during </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Vampyrism Gloves</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1487224784428335255.png?v=1" alt="vampyrismgloves" title="vampyrismgloves" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - heals the player for 2% of the damage they deal, up to a maximum of 20 life points restored per hit
    • Only works on hits dealing at least 1,000 damage
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="weapons"><ins><nowiki>Weapons</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="general-weapons-introduction"><nowiki>General Weapons Introduction</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The tier of a weapon is the listed equip requirement. Generally the damage and accuracy tier match that</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exceptions include: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1" alt="lanispear" title="lanispear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (T90 damage, T75 accuracy), GWD2 weapons (T80 damage, T90 accuracy), and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/915232154160594974.png?v=1" alt="darkiceshard" title="darkiceshard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/915232153787334677.png?v=1" alt="darkicesliver" title="darkicesliver" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (T88 damage, T85 accuracy)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For dual-wield weapons:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Overall damage tier is equal to 66% of the main hand's tier and 33% of the off-hand's tier</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Overall accuracy tier you have is equal to your main hand's tier fully.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For ammo'd </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> weapons and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> weapons:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage tier is equal to the minimum between the weapon tier and the ammo / spell tier</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ E.g. a T90 weapon with a T1 ammo / spell has T1 damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="defenders-and-shields"><ins><nowiki>Defenders and Shields</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Defenders and Shields</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ It is recommended to look up further information on the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Armoury <nowiki>Wiki</nowiki>]<nowiki>
⬥ Use </nowiki><code><nowiki>!defender</nowiki></code><nowiki> for info on obtaining defenders
⬥ Defender weapon and shield tier is half its tier (e.g. T90 defender is T45)
⬥ Defenders provide 3% accuracy and 1/15 chance to reduce hit by 50-100%
⬥ T90 shields' right-click voke option drops target when using queueing
⬥ Spirit shields reduce damage by 30%, 20% of it is removed from prayer
⬥ Shieldbows count as a MH + shield of its tier (e.g. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is a T70 MH + shield)
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Bone shield</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809125590450276.png?v=1" alt="lesserboneshield" title="lesserboneshield" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1" alt="greaterboneshield" title="greaterboneshield" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is unlocked via </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and allows the use of defensive shield abilities without a physical shield, costing necrotic runes.
    • With lvl120 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716261681307728.png?v=1" alt="zemouregalsnexus" title="zemouregalsnexus" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1" alt="greaterboneshield" title="greaterboneshield" kind="icon" /><nowiki> you can reach up to bone shield tier 75.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>T90 Shields</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Merciless </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553021457645579.png?v=1" alt="merciless" title="merciless" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)
⬥ Vengeful </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553026415313006.png?v=1" alt="vengeful" title="vengeful" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)
⬥ Malevolent </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553024536252466.png?v=1" alt="malevkite" title="malevkite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="Attack" title="Attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Spirit Shields (T75)</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Arcane </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690976219612708954.png?v=1" alt="arcanespiritshield" title="arcanespiritshield" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)
⬥ Elysian </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690976217792250007.png?v=1" alt="elysianspiritshield" title="elysianspiritshield" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)
⬥ Divine </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690976217792249896.png?v=1" alt="divinespiritshield" title="divinespiritshield" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="Attack" title="Attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)
⬥ Spectral </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148977577059430461.png?v=1" alt="spectralspiritshield" title="spectralspiritshield" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Defenders</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Corrupted </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/923248842000957480.png?v=1" alt="corrupteddefender" title="corrupteddefender" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (T70)
⬥ Ancient </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643150658891153428.png?v=1" alt="ancientrepriser" title="ancientrepriser" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (T80)
⬥ Kalphite </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846849223983125.png?v=1" alt="kalphiterebounder" title="kalphiterebounder" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (T90)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Shieldbows</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Darkbow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (T70)
⬥ Strykebow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643109318845267988.png?v=1" alt="strykebow" title="strykebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (T85)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Generally When to use What</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Bone shield </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809125590450276.png?v=1" alt="lesserboneshield" title="lesserboneshield" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1" alt="greaterboneshield" title="greaterboneshield" kind="icon" /><nowiki> work for most scenarios where a very high shield tier is unimportant 
    • Defenders when needing to do offensive shield abilities (e.g. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259645878302.png?v=1" alt="revenge" title="revenge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>), but are effectively superseded by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809125590450276.png?v=1" alt="lesserboneshield" title="lesserboneshield" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Spirit Shields when needing to use effect to tank large hits
⬥ Shieldbows when using a bow
⬥ T90 shields otherwise (e.g. for bigger </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or very long </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="rings"><ins><nowiki>Rings</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Rings</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><code><nowiki>!ring</nowiki></code><nowiki> to see when to use what ring
⬥ Rings covered: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1" alt="RoD" title="RoD" kind="icon" /><nowiki> | </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1" alt="channellerring" title="channellerring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> | </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943630520350.png?v=1" alt="championring" title="championring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> | </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943601029120.png?v=1" alt="stalkerring" title="stalkerring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> | </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1245442140318863490.png?v=1" alt="occulistring" title="occulistring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> | </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1232124265826877574.png?v=1" alt="zorgothsring" title="zorgothsring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> | </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1" alt="reaverring" title="reaverring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> | </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158472839208.png?v=1" alt="asr" title="asr" kind="icon" /><nowiki> | </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1" alt="rov" title="rov" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1" alt="RoD" title="RoD" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158472839208.png?v=1" alt="asr" title="asr" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be imbued for +2.5 style bonus at the Armoursmith for teci
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Ring of Death</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1" alt="RoD" title="RoD" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ On target death, 50% chance to gain 1% adren per 1.5k hp of it (caps at 5%)
⬥ On player death, the player is revived at full health and a damage-over-time effect is applied for three minutes
⬥ Overchargeable at Death for 5 cut onyx and 25 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643162243571122196.png?v=1" alt="blackstoneheart" title="blackstoneheart" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (has 5x charges)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Channeler's Ring</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1" alt="channellerring" title="channellerring" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Each hit of a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> channel has (4 * channel hits done)% more crit chance
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Metaphysics enchantment</nowiki></strong><nowiki> causes +(2.5 * channel hits done) % crit dmg
⬥ To clarify: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1" alt="channellerring" title="channellerring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and its enchantment </nowiki><strong><nowiki>only affect </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> channels, not autos, etc.</nowiki></strong><nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Champion's Ring</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943630520350.png?v=1" alt="championring" title="championring" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="Attack" title="Attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> attacks gain 3% (4% if </nowiki><strong><nowiki>heroism enchantment</nowiki></strong><nowiki>) crit chance if target bled
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Heroism enchantment</nowiki></strong><nowiki> also adds (1.5 * bleed count)% crit damage
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Stalker's Ring</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943601029120.png?v=1" alt="stalkerring" title="stalkerring" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Bow attacks gain 3% (4% if </nowiki><strong><nowiki>shadow enchantment</nowiki></strong><nowiki>) crit chance
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Shadow enchantment</nowiki></strong><nowiki> also adds 3% crit damage
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Occultist's ring</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1245442140318863490.png?v=1" alt="occulistring" title="occulistring" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ On cast, Necromancy attacks have a 10% chance to generate +2 stacks of Necrosis </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1" alt="necrosis" title="necrosis" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • This does not affect conjure attacks or Bloat </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after the first hit
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Zorgoth's soul ring</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1232124265826877574.png?v=1" alt="zorgothsring" title="zorgothsring" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Upgraded from Zorgoth's ring (quest reward from Requiem for a Dragon) while wearing it during rituals at the Ungael ritual site.
⬥ Necromancy hits have a 5% chance to generate +1 stack of Residual Soul </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • This does not affect conjure attacks or Bloat </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after the first hit
    • AOE abilities like Blood Siphon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1" alt="bloodsiphon" title="bloodsiphon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can proc for every target and every hit
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Other Rings</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Reaver's Ring</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1" alt="reaverring" title="reaverring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - +5% crit chance but -5% hitchance
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Asylum Surgeon's Ring</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158472839208.png?v=1" alt="asr" title="asr" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - 30s cooldown if either occur:

⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Ring of Vigour</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1" alt="rov" title="rov" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Ultimates refund 10% adren, spec cost reduced by 10%; this can be made passive via the Extinction quest

⬥ Can dye and use multiple </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439139400224849.png?v=1" alt="graspingpouch" title="graspingpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> | </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626450296892.png?v=1" alt="pernixsquiver" title="pernixsquiver" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Ammo Slots</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Armour Spikes:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/947871842541129768.png?v=1" alt="abyssalarmourspikesalloy" title="abyssalarmourspikesalloy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>abyssal (alloy)</nowiki></strong><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1276946271424479234.png?v=1" alt="primalabyssalarmourspikes" title="primalabyssalarmourspikes" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>primal abyssal</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - Deal damage equal to 100% / 125% of Smithing level, 10% chance to deal +900% / +1000% damage
    • 100% chance to apply a parasite stack
    • Must also wear melee gear and take damage / be MD
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Nodon Spike Harness</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1449363594495135776.png?v=1" alt="nodonspikeharness" title="nodonspikeharness" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - holds spikes and boosts their damage
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Grasping Rune Pouches</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439139400224849.png?v=1" alt="graspingpouch" title="graspingpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - holds 4 types of runes

⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Nexuses</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716442816532540.png?v=1" alt="deathwardennexus" title="deathwardennexus" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716261681307728.png?v=1" alt="zemouregalsnexus" title="zemouregalsnexus" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511690281320498.png?v=1" alt="devourersnexus" title="devourersnexus" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stores ectoplasm and necrotic runes

<div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Banking Preset</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>For an exhaustive list of everything you might want in a banking preset, see </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Quick Banking Preset</nowiki></strong><nowiki> in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#interface-guide</nowiki></span><nowiki>.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Preset Contents</nowiki></u><nowiki>
